news.title: How Pew Research Center is – and is not – using AI in our work
news.summary_en: In this post, we’ll share our current guidelines for the internal use of artificial intelligence and potential areas of experimentation.

news.title: Video: How precise are polls really?
news.summary_en: How precise are polls…really? Courtney Kennedy let’s us in on a little secret: even the best pollsters need some wiggle room when sharing results. This “wiggle room” (also known as the margin of error) is the range within the true answer likely falls.

news.title: More Americans now support than oppose all-day school cellphone bans
news.summary_en: Three-quarters of U.S. adults support in-class school cellphone bans, and for the first time, more now support than oppose all-day bans for middle and high schoolers.

news.title: Most Americans favor big changes to the political system that likely would require amending the Constitution
news.summary_en: Most Americans support term limits, campaign spending caps, and Electoral College reform, but achieving these changes likely would require amending one of the world’s hardest constitutions to change.

news.title: Canadians and Mexicans now view China more positively than the U.S.
news.summary_en: Canadians and Mexicans also now view Chinese President Xi Jinping more positively than Trump, even as relatively few people in both countries have confidence in the two leaders.
